{{Top|leg}}
"'''The Street Singer'''" was a [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] folk song. It was heard at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] shortly after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] won the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].
